Our Story

Built on
Craft &
Precision

Trinabh Industries is a full-scale modular furniture manufacturer based in India. Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery including automatic edge banders and CNC routers, we deliver furniture that fuses clean engineering with refined aesthetics.


From luxury residential interiors to complete commercial office fitouts — every piece that leaves our factory carries the mark of uncompromised quality and timeless design.

How We Work

Our Process

01
✦
Consultation & Design
In-depth consultation to understand your space, lifestyle and vision. Detailed 3D renders before a single board is cut.
02
⬡
Material Selection
Choose from premium laminates, high-gloss acrylics, veneers and hardware from Hettich, Century, Action Tesa and more.

04

The Factory

Where Ideas
Become Furniture

Our production facility is equipped with modern European-grade machinery — automatic edge banders, panel saws and CNC routing centres — ensuring millimeter-level precision at scale.

⚡
Automatic Edge Bander
Flawless finish on all panels — zero gaps, zero lifting, consistent quality every time.
📐
CNC Panel Processing
Precision cuts, bore holes and custom profiles with ±0.1mm accuracy.
🏭
In-House Assembly
All components assembled and checked at our facility before dispatch.
✅
Multi-Point QC
Rigorous quality checks at every production stage — from raw material to final product.
